inference_resolution.example_level_role: paired descriptive precision within a training seed; examples do not increase the number of independent trained-model clusters
inference_resolution.interpretation: The study has high within-seed sample density but only five independent training seeds per scale. Exact and multiplicity-adjusted seed-level p-values are reported, while causal success requires effect direction, corrected seed-cluster intervals, memory matching, and five-of-five seed consistency rather than an unattainable p<0.05 threshold.

adequacy_decision.sample_density: paper-grade if every preregistered artifact reaches terminal audit
adequacy_decision.model_breadth: bounded single-family transfer evidence; not a population-level claim
adequacy_decision.target_architecture: unverified until official DeepSeek-V4 weights and compatible serving runtime are provisioned
adequacy_decision.systems_breadth: reference and checked static continuous batching are reportable separately; external dynamic fused and multi-GPU serving remain unverified
adequacy_decision.next_extension: after the frozen primary run, replicate the chosen operating point on a second instruction-tuned model family only if the primary causal gate is positive or scientifically ambiguous

non_aggregation_rule: Do not add synthetic policy-example evaluations, language-model predictions, and systems repetitions into one headline sample count; report each experimental unit separately.
claim_boundary: The planned volume is competitive in sample density and failure accounting but intentionally narrower than multi-model benchmark papers. Completion supports a deep single-compatible-model study, not broad model-family or official DeepSeek-V4 generalization.
